quran_text_all_rows.arabic_uthmani: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ

ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ فَاطِرِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ جَاعِلِ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ رُسُلًا أُو۟لِىٓ أَجْنِحَةٍۢ مَّثْنَىٰ وَثُلَٰثَ وَرُبَٰعَ ۚ يَزِيدُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ
مَّا يَفْتَحِ ٱللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ مِن رَّحْمَةٍۢ فَلَا مُمْسِكَ لَهَا ۖ وَمَا يُمْسِكْ فَلَا مُرْسِلَ لَهُۥ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ ۚ هَلْ مِنْ خَٰلِقٍ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ يَرْزُقُكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُؤْفَكُونَ
وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كُذِّبَتْ رُسُلٌۭ مِّن قَبْلِكَ ۚ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ ٱلْأُمُورُ
يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّۭ ۖ فَلَا تَغُرَّنَّكُمُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَا يَغُرَّنَّكُم بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْغَرُورُ
إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّۭ فَٱتَّخِذُوهُ عَدُوًّا ۚ إِنَّمَا يَدْعُوا۟ حِزْبَهُۥ لِيَكُونُوا۟ مِنْ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ شَدِيدٌۭ ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَأَجْرٌۭ كَبِيرٌ

أَفَمَن زُيِّنَ لَهُۥ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ فَرَءَاهُ حَسَنًۭا ۖ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُضِلُّ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۖ فَلَا تَذْهَبْ نَفْسُكَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَسَرَٰتٍ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِمَا يَصْنَعُونَ
وَٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَرْسَلَ ٱلرِّيَٰحَ فَتُثِيرُ سَحَابًۭا فَسُقْنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ بَلَدٍۢ مَّيِّتٍۢ فَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلنُّشُورُ

مَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ ٱلْعِزَّةَ فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْعِزَّةُ جَمِيعًا ۚ إِلَيْهِ يَصْعَدُ ٱلْكَلِمُ ٱلطَّيِّبُ وَٱلْعَمَلُ ٱلصَّٰلِحُ يَرْفَعُهُۥ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ يَمْكُرُونَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ شَدِيدٌۭ ۖ وَمَكْرُ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُوَ يَبُورُ

وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُم مِّن تُرَابٍۢ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطْفَةٍۢ ثُمَّ جَعَلَكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًۭا ۚ وَمَا تَحْمِلُ مِنْ أُنثَىٰ وَلَا تَضَعُ إِلَّا بِعِلْمِهِۦ ۚ وَمَا يُعَمَّرُ مِن مُّعَمَّرٍۢ وَلَا يُنقَصُ مِنْ عُمُرِهِۦٓ إِلَّا فِى كِتَٰبٍ ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌۭ

وَمَا يَسْتَوِى ٱلْبَحْرَانِ هَٰذَا عَذْبٌۭ فُرَاتٌۭ سَآئِغٌۭ شَرَابُهُۥ وَهَٰذَا مِلْحٌ أُجَاجٌۭ ۖ وَمِن كُلٍّۢ تَأْكُلُونَ لَحْمًۭا طَرِيًّۭا وَتَسْتَخْرِجُونَ حِلْيَةًۭ تَلْبَسُونَهَا ۖ وَتَرَى ٱلْفُلْكَ فِيهِ مَوَاخِرَ لِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ

يُولِجُ ٱلَّيْلَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ كُلٌّۭ يَجْرِى لِأَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّۭى ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَهُ ٱلْمُلْكُ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِن قِطْمِيرٍ
إِن تَدْعُوهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُوا۟ دُعَآءَكُمْ وَلَوْ سَمِعُوا۟ مَا ٱسْتَجَابُوا۟ لَكُمْ ۖ وَيَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ يَكْفُرُونَ بِشِرْكِكُمْ ۚ وَلَا يُنَبِّئُكَ مِثْلُ خَبِيرٍۢ
۞ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ أَنتُمُ ٱلْفُقَرَآءُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ هُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ
إِن يَشَأْ يُذْهِبْكُمْ وَيَأْتِ بِخَلْقٍۢ جَدِيدٍۢ
وَمَا ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ بِعَزِيزٍۢ

وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌۭ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ ۚ وَإِن تَدْعُ مُثْقَلَةٌ إِلَىٰ حِمْلِهَا لَا يُحْمَلْ مِنْهُ شَىْءٌۭ وَلَوْ كَانَ ذَا قُرْبَىٰٓ ۗ إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَأَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ ۚ وَمَن تَزَكَّىٰ فَإِنَّمَا يَتَزَكَّىٰ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۚ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
وَمَا يَسْتَوِى ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ وَٱلْبَصِيرُ
وَلَا ٱلظُّلُمَٰتُ وَلَا ٱلنُّورُ
وَلَا ٱلظِّلُّ وَلَا ٱلْحَرُورُ
وَمَا يَسْتَوِى ٱلْأَحْيَآءُ وَلَا ٱلْأَمْوَٰتُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُسْمِعُ مَن يَشَآءُ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ بِمُسْمِعٍۢ مَّن فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ
إِنْ أَنتَ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ
إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ بَشِيرًۭا وَنَذِيرًۭا ۚ وَإِن مِّنْ أُمَّةٍ إِلَّا خَلَا فِيهَا نَذِيرٌۭ
وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ جَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ وَبِٱلزُّبُرِ وَبِٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْمُنِيرِ
ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۖ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ

أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَأَخْرَجْنَا بِهِۦ ثَمَرَٰتٍۢ مُّخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَٰنُهَا ۚ وَمِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ جُدَدٌۢ بِيضٌۭ وَحُمْرٌۭ مُّخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَٰنُهَا وَغَرَابِيبُ سُودٌۭ
وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَٱلدَّوَآبِّ وَٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ مُخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَٰنُهُۥ كَذَٰلِكَ ۗ إِنَّمَا يَخْشَى ٱللَّهَ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ ٱلْعُلَمَٰٓؤُا۟ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ غَفُورٌ
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَتْلُونَ كِتَٰبَ ٱللَّهِ وَأَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَأَنفَقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ سِرًّۭا وَعَلَانِيَةًۭ يَرْجُونَ تِجَٰرَةًۭ لَّن تَبُورَ
لِيُوَفِّيَهُمْ أُجُورَهُمْ وَيَزِيدَهُم مِّن فَضْلِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ غَفُورٌۭ شَكُورٌۭ
وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ مِنَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ مُصَدِّقًۭا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِعِبَادِهِۦ لَخَبِيرٌۢ بَصِيرٌۭ

ثُمَّ أَوْرَثْنَا ٱلْكِتَٰبَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱصْطَفَيْنَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ۖ فَمِنْهُمْ ظَالِمٌۭ لِّنَفْسِهِۦ وَمِنْهُم مُّقْتَصِدٌۭ وَمِنْهُمْ سَابِقٌۢ بِٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَضْلُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
جَنَّٰتُ عَدْنٍۢ يَدْخُلُونَهَا يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيهَا مِنْ أَسَاوِرَ مِن ذَهَبٍۢ وَلُؤْلُؤًۭا ۖ وَلِبَاسُهُمْ فِيهَا حَرِيرٌۭ
وَقَالُوا۟ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَذْهَبَ عَنَّا ٱلْحَزَنَ ۖ إِنَّ رَبَّنَا لَغَفُورٌۭ شَكُورٌ
ٱلَّذِىٓ أَحَلَّنَا دَارَ ٱلْمُقَامَةِ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ لَا يَمَسُّنَا فِيهَا نَصَبٌۭ وَلَا يَمَسُّنَا فِيهَا لُغُوبٌۭ
وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَهُمْ نَارُ جَهَنَّمَ لَا يُقْضَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ فَيَمُوتُوا۟ وَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُم مِّنْ عَذَابِهَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى كُلَّ كَفُورٍۢ

وَهُمْ يَصْطَرِخُونَ فِيهَا رَبَّنَآ أَخْرِجْنَا نَعْمَلْ صَٰلِحًا غَيْرَ ٱلَّذِى كُنَّا نَعْمَلُ ۚ أَوَلَمْ نُعَمِّرْكُم مَّا يَتَذَكَّرُ فِيهِ مَن تَذَكَّرَ وَجَآءَكُمُ ٱلنَّذِيرُ ۖ فَذُوقُوا۟ فَمَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ مِن نَّصِيرٍ
إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَٰلِمُ غَيْبِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ

هُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَكُمْ خَلَٰٓئِفَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ فَمَن كَفَرَ فَعَلَيْهِ كُفْرُهُۥ ۖ وَلَا يَزِيدُ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ كُفْرُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا مَقْتًۭا ۖ وَلَا يَزِيدُ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ كُفْرُهُمْ إِلَّا خَسَارًۭا

قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ شُرَكَآءَكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَرُونِى مَاذَا خَلَقُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ لَهُمْ شِرْكٌۭ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ أَمْ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمْ كِتَٰبًۭا فَهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَتٍۢ مِّنْهُ ۚ بَلْ إِن يَعِدُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ بَعْضُهُم بَعْضًا إِلَّا غُرُورًا
۞ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُمْسِكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ أَن تَزُولَا ۚ وَلَئِن زَالَتَآ إِنْ أَمْسَكَهُمَا مِنْ أَحَدٍۢ مِّنۢ بَعْدِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ حَلِيمًا غَفُورًۭا
وَأَقْسَمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَٰنِهِمْ لَئِن جَآءَهُمْ نَذِيرٌۭ لَّيَكُونُنَّ أَهْدَىٰ مِنْ إِحْدَى ٱلْأُمَمِ ۖ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ نَذِيرٌۭ مَّا زَادَهُمْ إِلَّا نُفُورًا

ٱسْتِكْبَارًۭا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَكْرَ ٱلسَّيِّئِ ۚ وَلَا يَحِيقُ ٱلْمَكْرُ ٱلسَّيِّئُ إِلَّا بِأَهْلِهِۦ ۚ فَهَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا سُنَّتَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ ۚ فَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ ٱللَّهِ تَبْدِيلًۭا ۖ وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ ٱللَّهِ تَحْوِيلًا

أَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ وَكَانُوٓا۟ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةًۭ ۚ وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيُعْجِزَهُۥ مِن شَىْءٍۢ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَلَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَلِيمًۭا قَدِيرًۭا

وَلَوْ يُؤَاخِذُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلنَّاسَ بِمَا كَسَبُوا۟ مَا تَرَكَ عَلَىٰ ظَهْرِهَا مِن دَآبَّةٍۢ وَلَٰكِن يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّۭى ۖ فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَجَلُهُمْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهِۦ بَصِيرًۢا

parent_channels.name: P1 (35:1-14) Aperture, Containment, and Flow

subchannels.name: Opening into release
subchannels.scene_or_process: A closure splits or widens, a latent content erupts, and what was folded or confined spreads into an open course.
subchannels.active_motifs: opened closure (quranic:root_001124:B001/m01); water issuing from an outlet (quranic:root_001124:B005/m01); split or fissure (quranic:root_001165:B001/m01); unfolding and branching spread (quranic:root_001503:B001/m01); eruption from quiescence (quranic:root_000210:B001/m01); widening until flow becomes possible (quranic:root_001559:B003/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 35:1 `فَاطِرِ` (ف ط ر); 35:2 `يَفْتَحِ` (ف ت ح); 35:9 `تُثِيرُ/ٱلنُّشُورُ` (ث و ر/ن ش ر); 35:13 `ٱلنَّهَارِ` (ن ه ر).
subchannels.synthesis: The opening of mercy is materialized as a breached closure whose contents emerge, spread, and acquire a widened outlet. The resurrection root at 35:9 participates not only in revival but in the physical act of unfolding what had been closed.

subchannels.name: Reservoir, well, and irrigated ground
subchannels.scene_or_process: Water is caught in a depression or rock cavity, retained by a firm boundary, then conducted through soil until the ground is fit.
subchannels.active_motifs: water-gathering low ground (quranic:root_000086:B006/m01); rock cavity or newly dug well (quranic:root_000434:B011/m01); water-retaining site (quranic:root_001424:B004/m01); river cutting a channel (quranic:root_001559:B001/m01); water sent across soil to improve it (quranic:root_001405:B003/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Retention and release become one irrigation mechanism: a firm cavity first keeps water from vanishing, while a cut channel later distributes it through the land. This gives the opening and withholding of 35:2 a material analogue in managed water.

subchannels.name: Ship cleaving a moving medium
subchannels.scene_or_process: A vessel enters flowing water, cuts it under way, and is managed by a water-skilled operator.
subchannels.active_motifs: continuous flowing motion (quranic:root_000240:B001/m01); ship circulating on water (quranic:root_001177:B003/m01); hull cleaving water with motion and sound (quranic:root_001405:B001/m01); sailor and navigation craft (quranic:root_001442:B006/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 35:12 `ٱلْفُلْكَ/مَوَاخِرَ/مِلْحٌ` (ف ل ك/م خ ر/م ل ح); 35:13 `يَجْرِى` (ج ر ي).
subchannels.synthesis: The visible ships of 35:12 form a complete transport scene: current, vessel, cleaving operation, and operator. The vessel does not merely occupy the sea; it converts resistance into a traversable course.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Matter or force becomes effective through a controlled relation between opening, channel, boundary, and release.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Mercy, rain, and maritime motion acquire a concrete hydraulic architecture of apertures, water-holding cavities, irrigated ground, and channels cut by moving water.

parent_channels.name: P1 (35:1-14) Atmospheric Delivery and Vegetal Renewal

subchannels.name: Wind, cloud mass, and rain-bearing transport
subchannels.scene_or_process: Wind moves through the air, draws a cloud body into view, and carries a layered load whose descent functions as provision.
subchannels.active_motifs: wind and moving air (quranic:root_000609:B003/m01); trailing cloud (quranic:root_000680:B002/m01); water-bearing cloud load (quranic:root_000357:B010/m01); cloud emergence and clearing sky (quranic:root_000400:B005/m01); layered cloud mass (quranic:root_000532:B008/m01); rain descending as provision (quranic:root_000560:B003/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Wind supplies motion, the cloud supplies a carried body, and rain supplies the delivered resource. The cloud is lexically a load and a layered mass, making atmospheric transport structurally parallel to the surah's other acts of sending and carrying.

subchannels.name: Dead ground returning to yield
subchannels.scene_or_process: Unproductive ground receives rain, dry herbage greens again, tender shoots emerge, and the revived land produces a crop.
subchannels.active_motifs: soft fertile ground (quranic:root_000025:B002/m01); land's life through rain and vegetation (quranic:root_000383:B002/m01); dead unused land (quranic:root_001454:B003/m01); dry herbage revived by rain (quranic:root_001503:B004/m01); tender shoot emergence (quranic:root_000810:B004/m01); trees breaking into leaf and plants lengthening (quranic:root_000609:B017/m01); crop and tree yield (quranic:root_000043:B002/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Revival is staged as a causal sequence rather than a generic fertility image: dead ground, rain contact, regreening, shoot emergence, and edible yield. The result makes resurrection legible through the mechanics of seasonal plant return.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A mobile atmospheric carrier delivers water that reverses terrestrial dormancy into growth and yield.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 35:9 explicitly sends wind, raises cloud, and revives dead land, while 35:3 and 35:12 frame rain and produce as provision.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The resurrection analogy expands into fine-grained plant processes: water-laden cloud mass, returning green in dry herbage, bursting shoots, and tree growth after seasonal recession.

parent_channels.name: P1 (35:1-14) Formation and Fixation

subchannels.name: Origination as deliberate making
subchannels.scene_or_process: An agent initiates, makes, and brings a formed entity into existence.
subchannels.active_motifs: making or producing a thing (quranic:root_000248:B001/m01); creative bringing-into-being (quranic:root_000434:B002/m01); performed manufacture (quranic:root_000885:B001/m01); origination and first emergence (quranic:root_001165:B002/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 35:1 `فَاطِرِ/جَاعِلِ/خَلْقِ` (ف ط ر/ج ع ل/خ ل ق); 35:3 `خَٰلِقٍ` (خ ل ق); 35:8 `يَصْنَعُ` (ص ن ع); 35:11 `خَلَقَ/جَعَلَ` (خ ل ق/ج ع ل).
subchannels.synthesis: The motifs distinguish initiation, fabrication, and emergence while keeping them in one production scene. Creation appears as the controlled establishment of form, not only as an abstract assertion of existence.

subchannels.name: Inscription, decree, and roster
subchannels.scene_or_process: Marks are arranged into writing, writing fixes a binding determination, and names can be entered into a durable register.
subchannels.active_motifs: ordered letters and written artifact (quranic:root_001283:B002/m01); binding written decree (quranic:root_001283:B003/m01); enrollment in a register (quranic:root_001283:B004/m01); published or unsealed writing (quranic:root_001503:B009/m01); retraced inscription or tattoo lines (quranic:root_000544:B009/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The book of 35:11 activates several operations that should remain distinct: composing signs, fixing a decree, and entering a name in a roster. Retraced lines add the material act by which a mark is renewed so that its determination remains visible.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: An intended form is brought into being and then stabilized as an artifact, inscription, rule, or record.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 35:1 and 35:11 name making and creation, while 35:11 fixes lifespan in a `كِتَٰب`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Creation and writing converge as two kinds of form-making: one shapes beings, while the other arranges marks and makes an order durable.

parent_channels.name: P1 (35:1-14) Reception and Report

subchannels.name: Sight becoming inward knowledge
subchannels.scene_or_process: A visible object is perceived, reflected upon, and penetrated until its inner condition becomes known.
subchannels.active_motifs: sight by eye or insight (quranic:root_000531:B001/m01); reflective judgment of the heart (quranic:root_000531:B002/m01); disclosure to the knower (quranic:root_001040:B001/m01); knowledge of a report's interior (quranic:root_000387:B001/m01); accurate wisdom (quranic:root_000348:B003/m01); opening an intellectual obstruction (quranic:root_001124:B008/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Seeing is not the endpoint. The scene moves from visual contact to reflection, accurate judgment, and knowledge of what lies beneath the report's exterior, with opening serving as the mechanism that makes insight possible.

subchannels.name: Call, hearing, and returned answer
subchannels.scene_or_process: A caller directs speech outward; a recipient hears, understands, and causes another to hear; an answer returns along the same communicative path.
subchannels.active_motifs: voiced call or summons (quranic:root_000478:B001/m01); auditory reception (quranic:root_000741:B001/m01); understanding and compliance after hearing (quranic:root_000741:B003/m01); causing another to hear (quranic:root_000741:B004/m01); verbal answer (quranic:root_000273:B003/m01); speech returned to its sender (quranic:root_000544:B005/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The failed appeal to the invoked beings is measured against a complete response circuit: call, reception, comprehension, induced hearing, and returned speech. The surface denial removes each functional stage of that circuit.

subchannels.name: News circulated or turned into falsehood
subchannels.scene_or_process: A meaningful utterance is carried and publicized, but it may be diverted from truth or used to mark its bearer as a liar.
subchannels.active_motifs: meaningful word or utterance (quranic:root_001316:B002/m01); reported news (quranic:root_001464:B002/m01); broadcasting a report (quranic:root_000582:B005/m01); mention carried on the tongue (quranic:root_000516:B004/m01); lie turned away from truth (quranic:root_000041:B002/m01); attribution of lying (quranic:root_001290:B002/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Communication is a transport scene whose cargo can remain true or be redirected. Broadcasting raises a report into public circulation, while lying is lexically a deflection that bends the report away from its proper referent.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Meaning moves from disclosure through perception into response, report, or distortion.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 35:3 calls for recollection, 35:8 contrasts seeing and knowledge, 35:10 raises good speech, and 35:14 stages a call that is neither heard nor answered.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The scene includes both receptive organs and communication logistics: insight opens an obstruction, news is broadcast, speech returns as an answer, and falsehood is a report diverted from its proper direction.

parent_channels.name: P1 (35:1-14) Mediating Surfaces

subchannels.name: Crafted beauty and disfigurement
subchannels.scene_or_process: A visible surface is judged, polished, or staged so that it appears attractive rather than defective.
subchannels.active_motifs: beauty opposed to ugliness (quranic:root_000323:B001/m01); ugliness and bad form (quranic:root_000755:B001/m01); beauty free of blemish (quranic:root_000660:B001/m01); active beautification (quranic:root_000660:B002/m01); self-fashioning and cosmetic display (quranic:root_000885:B004/m01); visible aspect and mirror-image (quranic:root_000531:B006/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 35:8 `حَسَنًا/سُوٓءُ/زُيِّنَ/رَءَا/يَصْنَعُ` (ح س ن/س و ء/ز ي ن/ر ء ي/ص ن ع); 35:10 `سَّيِّـَٔاتِ` (س و ء); 35:12 `تَرَى` (ر ء ي).
subchannels.synthesis: The scene distinguishes intrinsic appraisal, deliberate enhancement, and the beholder's visible impression. The beautified evil of 35:8 is therefore not merely misjudged; it is lexically compatible with a crafted presentation designed to manage the viewer.

subchannels.name: Cover, veil, and armor
subchannels.scene_or_process: A layer is placed over a vulnerable body or object to conceal, preserve, or defend it.
subchannels.active_motifs: protective covering (quranic:root_001096:B001/m01); covering over object or weapon (quranic:root_001307:B001/m01); bodily garment (quranic:root_001341:B001/m01); armor worn for defense (quranic:root_001341:B002/m01); tent-like fine screen (quranic:root_001315:B006/m01); garment or shield (quranic:root_000273:B005/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Moral covering, ordinary dress, and martial defense share the operation of interposing a layer. The channel gives forgiveness and concealment a concrete protective geometry without collapsing them into the same surface reading.

subchannels.name: Hide converted into leather
subchannels.scene_or_process: A marked animal surface loses hair or flesh, is stripped, and becomes a skin capable of holding contents.
subchannels.active_motifs: mark left on skin (quranic:root_000148:B006/m01); hide retaining hair during dressing (quranic:root_000844:B006/m01); skin that holds what is inside (quranic:root_001424:B005/m01); flesh stripped from bone (quranic:root_001348:B009/m01); shedding feather, hair, or old coat (quranic:root_000320:B005/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The surface becomes a worked material through shedding, stripping, and retention. This scene sharpens the distinction between living covering and manufactured container while keeping both within one conversion process.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A surface controls how an entity appears, what it exposes, and what it protects.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 35:8 presents an ugly deed made to look fair, while 35:12 presents extracted ornament and worn covering.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Appearance is grounded in craft and material layers: cosmetic display, armor, veil, hairy hide, leather container, and the stripping of flesh from bone.

parent_channels.name: P1 (35:1-14) Generative Bodies

subchannels.name: Human gestation and birth
subchannels.scene_or_process: A female body receives and carries an interior growth in the womb until birth and postpartum emergence.
subchannels.active_motifs: female sex (quranic:root_000058:B001/m01); interior pregnancy or fruit (quranic:root_000357:B002/m01); womb as the child's growing receptacle (quranic:root_000552:B003/m01); delivery of the carried fetus (quranic:root_001657:B002/m01); birth and postpartum blood (quranic:root_001533:B005/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The surface statement is expanded into a role-complete bodily process: female participant, womb-container, carried growth, delivery, and postpartum outcome. The pregnancy motif also preserves its plant-fruit extension without merging the two entities.

subchannels.name: Livestock courtship and uncertain conception
subchannels.scene_or_process: A female desires mating, a stallion rises and bellows before mounting, and later signs either confirm pregnancy or disclose failed conception.
subchannels.active_motifs: female animal seeking the male (quranic:root_000248:B009/m01); stallion rising over females (quranic:root_000745:B003/m01); stallion's warning bellow before attack (quranic:root_001662:B005/m01); pregnancy becoming visibly apparent in ewe or camel (quranic:root_000531:B010/m01); suspected pregnancy that fails or is lost (quranic:root_000544:B013/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The lexical evidence forms a distinct animal reproductive sequence rather than an undifferentiated fertility theme. Display, threat, mating readiness, and uncertain gestation make generation vulnerable to failure as well as productive completion.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Generation proceeds through sexed bodies, an interior receptacle, gestational change, and eventual emergence.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 35:11 names female pregnancy and delivery after the creation of human pairs.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The human sequence is mirrored by a complete livestock scene of estrus, stallion display, threatened mounting, uncertain conception, and visible pregnancy.

parent_channels.name: P1 (35:1-14) Verticalized Power

subchannels.name: Ascent and increasing height
subchannels.scene_or_process: A body or utterance rises, gains height, and continues upward by increments.
subchannels.active_motifs: elevation and upwardness (quranic:root_000745:B001/m01); ascent toward a higher place (quranic:root_000862:B001/m01); increase in height or measure (quranic:root_000862:B008/m01); lifting a body from its place (quranic:root_000582:B001/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The upward route of good speech is materially continuous with bodily ascent and incremental height. The process separates the motion itself from the status that the motion can later signify.

subchannels.name: Rank, dominance, and dominion
subchannels.scene_or_process: An elevated position becomes recognized rank, coercive advantage, effective capacity, and rule over a domain.
subchannels.active_motifs: elevation of rank (quranic:root_000582:B002/m01); strength and honor after lowliness (quranic:root_001008:B001/m01); dominance over a rival (quranic:root_001008:B002/m01); kingship and political dominion (quranic:root_001444:B003/m01); effective capacity to act and own (quranic:root_001205:B003/m01); lordship, ownership, and command (quranic:root_000532:B001/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Rank is not treated as a synonym for ascent. It is the social and political outcome produced when elevation becomes capacity, victory, ownership, and stable command.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Upward motion becomes a model for increased rank, effective strength, and sovereign command.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 35:10 makes good speech ascend and righteous action raise it, while 35:1, 35:2, 35:10, and 35:13 name power, might, and dominion.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Physical elevation and political hierarchy are linked by a shared upward operation, but remain distinct scenes of movement and rule.

parent_channels.name: P1 (35:1-14) Provision in Circulation

subchannels.name: Market movement and stagnation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Goods are brought to a market, priced, and made current; when circulation fails, the market and its stock stagnate toward spoilage.
subchannels.active_motifs: market stagnation leading to spoilage (quranic:root_000164:B002/m01); market price (quranic:root_000708:B003/m01); marketplace for sale and purchase (quranic:root_000762:B005/m01); a market becoming current (quranic:root_001273:B018/m01); a sale reversed and replaced (quranic:root_000544:B011/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Perishing is specified as failed circulation: unsold goods cease moving and decay. Pricing, market space, and reversed sale turn the fate of the plot in 35:10 into an economic mechanism rather than a bare synonym for destruction.

subchannels.name: Wage, assigned share, and continuing yield
subchannels.scene_or_process: Work generates an agreed payment, provision is apportioned, and a continuing grant returns benefit to its recipient.
subchannels.active_motifs: wage or recompense for work (quranic:root_000015:B001/m01); fee fixed for a task (quranic:root_000248:B005/m01); apportioned provision (quranic:root_000560:B001/m01); worker's wage or ration (quranic:root_001046:B004/m01); continuing grant or provision (quranic:root_000240:B006/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Reward is a structured return on action: a task, a fixed fee, an apportioned share, and a continuing flow. The channel keeps payment distinct from botanical yield while preserving their common productive-return invariant.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Value remains productive when goods, payment, and assigned shares circulate; blockage turns circulation into stagnation and loss.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 35:3 names assigned provision, 35:7 names reward, 35:10 says the plot will perish, and 35:12 depicts extraction and travel in pursuit of bounty.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The moral economy is rendered through a literal marketplace with pricing, sale, circulation, wage, and market stagnation.

parent_channels.name: P2 (35:15-30) Receptive Thresholds

subchannels.name: Eye, blindness, and inward sight
subchannels.scene_or_process: The eye receives a visible object, but full perception requires an inward faculty that can be present or absent independently of eyesight.
subchannels.active_motifs: eyesight (quranic:root_000121:B001/m01); insight of the heart (quranic:root_000121:B002/m01); loss of eyesight (quranic:root_001049:B001/m01); blindness of heart and judgment (quranic:root_001049:B002/m01); sight by eye or insight (quranic:root_000531:B001/m01); disclosure to the knower (quranic:root_001040:B001/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Physical sight and inward discernment form separate but coordinated operations. The contrast at 35:19 therefore reaches beyond ocular capacity to the heart's ability to recognize what vision presents.

subchannels.name: Light, shade, and blinding heat
subchannels.scene_or_process: Illumination exposes, shade interposes a protective cover, and extreme noon heat can itself disable sight.
subchannels.active_motifs: illumination (quranic:root_001564:B001/m01); shade as covering (quranic:root_000966:B001/m01); overhead shade or canopy (quranic:root_000966:B003/m01); heat opposed to cold (quranic:root_000306:B001/m01); blinding midday heat (quranic:root_001049:B008/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Visibility is regulated by exposure and cover, not by light alone. The latent blinding noon image complicates the simple equation of brightness with sight: excessive exposure can close the same perceptual threshold that ordinary light opens.

subchannels.name: Hearing across the life-death boundary
subchannels.scene_or_process: Sound is received and understood by living participants, while the dead are enclosed in a place whose depth and closure block ordinary response.
subchannels.active_motifs: auditory reception (quranic:root_000741:B001/m01); understanding and compliance after hearing (quranic:root_000741:B003/m01); causing another to hear (quranic:root_000741:B004/m01); living animate being (quranic:root_000383:B003/m01); loss of life and force (quranic:root_001454:B001/m01); burial enclosure (quranic:root_001195:B001/m01); sunken or sealed recess (quranic:root_001195:B002/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 35:22 `أَحْيَآءُ/أَمْوَٰتُ/يُسْمِعُ/مُسْمِعٍ/قُبُورِ` (ح ي ي/م و ت/س م ع/ق ب ر).
subchannels.synthesis: Hearing is staged as a trans-boundary operation whose ordinary participants are alive and reachable. The grave's lexical depth and enclosure materialize why a merely human call cannot establish the missing response circuit.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Perception depends on whether light, sound, and life can cross a receptive threshold.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 35:19-22 contrast blind and seeing, shadow and heat, living and dead, and hearing with the silence of graves.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The contrasts become mechanisms of access: inward insight, blinding noon, induced hearing, and the grave as a sealed or sunken enclosure.

parent_channels.name: P2 (35:15-30) Burden and Liability

subchannels.name: Load, weight, and attempted relief
subchannels.scene_or_process: A heavy load slows its bearer and is carried bodily or as an entrusted obligation, yet it remains attached to that bearer.
subchannels.active_motifs: heaviness and slowed movement (quranic:root_000202:B006/m01); externally carried load (quranic:root_000357:B001/m01); entrusted burden or fault (quranic:root_000357:B003/m01); heavy moral load (quranic:root_001643:B002/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 35:18 `مُثْقَلَةٌ/حِمْلِ/يُحْمَلْ/تَزِرُ/وَازِرَةٌ/وِزْرَ` (ث ق ل/ح م ل/و ز ر).
subchannels.synthesis: The verse's burden becomes both weight and entrusted responsibility. Physical carriage and moral liability converge without implying that either can be detached from the accountable bearer.

subchannels.name: Surety, attached right, and non-transfer
subchannels.scene_or_process: A claim follows its owner, a guarantor may stand for another, and a surety can carry a liability without erasing the original right.
subchannels.active_motifs: liability or right that follows its bearer (quranic:root_000186:B004/m01); proprietary right (quranic:root_000347:B003/m01); guarantee for damages or debt (quranic:root_000357:B004/m01); surety and standing for another (quranic:root_001332:B003/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Responsibility is mapped as an attached legal relation rather than a detachable object. Guarantee can add a responsible party, but the following right and original claim remain structurally intact.

subchannels.name: Fault, seizure, and protective forgiveness
subchannels.scene_or_process: An agent is seized for an act and held to account, or is protected from the act's consequence by a covering operation.
subchannels.active_motifs: being held to account for fault (quranic:root_000018:B002/m01); forgiveness shielding from consequence (quranic:root_001096:B002/m01); erasure of fault by covering it (quranic:root_001307:B009/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Accountability and forgiveness are opposite operations on the same consequence relation: one enforces the act's effect, while the other interposes protection or effaces the recorded fault.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A burden remains attached to its bearer unless a valid relation of surety, right, or relief changes its legal or physical disposition.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 35:18 denies transfer of one burden to another bearer and then turns to purification and final return.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The moral image expands into transport equipment, guarantee, debt, and legal entitlement, distinguishing physical carriage from juridical responsibility.

parent_channels.name: P2 (35:15-30) Textual Witness

subchannels.name: Written artifact, correction, and decree
subchannels.scene_or_process: Letters are composed into a document, corrected into regular form, and used to fix a judgment or enroll a name.
subchannels.active_motifs: writing and written book (quranic:root_000621:B003/m01); ordered letters and written artifact (quranic:root_001283:B002/m01); binding written decree (quranic:root_001283:B003/m01); enrollment in a register (quranic:root_001283:B004/m01); correction of book and account (quranic:root_000306:B005/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The text is a worked and regulated artifact. Composition, correction, decree, and enrollment are separate operations that together explain how a writing can function as stable witness.

subchannels.name: Following, dispatch, and delivery
subchannels.scene_or_process: A predecessor is followed, a messenger is dispatched with carried speech, and the message is delivered to its destination.
subchannels.active_motifs: following in sequence (quranic:root_000186:B001/m01); sending or dispatch (quranic:root_000563:B001/m01); messenger and carried message (quranic:root_000563:B002/m01); descent or delivery of a thing (quranic:root_001492:B002/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The lexical following in 35:29 materializes recitation as ordered attachment to a prior text. Dispatch and delivery extend that order into a communication route with sender, carrier, and recipient.

subchannels.name: Truth disclosed against fabrication
subchannels.scene_or_process: A claim corresponds to reality, is made clear by sign or speech, and confronts both fabricated discourse and the attribution of lying.
subchannels.active_motifs: truth corresponding to reality (quranic:root_000347:B001/m01); proof that establishes truth (quranic:root_000347:B005/m01); manifest evidence (quranic:root_000170:B004/m01); explanatory disclosure by speech or sign (quranic:root_000170:B005/m01); falsehood opposed to truth (quranic:root_001290:B001/m01); attribution of lying (quranic:root_001290:B002/m01); fabricated speech (quranic:root_000434:B007/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Evidence is not merely present; it performs disclosure and tests correspondence. Fabrication produces speech without a real referent, while clear proof reconnects the claim to what is fixed.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Truth is stabilized, transmitted, and tested through durable marks, ordered following, and public evidence.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 35:24-25 bring messengers, clear proofs, scrolls, and an illuminating book, while 35:29 presents following or reciting the book.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Textuality includes editing, enrollment, and the bodily or procedural act of following, not only a finished book.

parent_channels.name: P2 (35:15-30) Sufficiency and Exchange

subchannels.name: Need, appetite, and sufficiency
subchannels.scene_or_process: Material lack or an unbounded appetite creates dependence, while sufficient means allow an agent to stand without that need.
subchannels.active_motifs: material need and poverty (quranic:root_001169:B002/m01); appetite-driven poverty of the self (quranic:root_001169:B004/m01); wealth and independence (quranic:root_001110:B001/m01); sufficiency that stands in for another resource (quranic:root_001110:B002/m01); fortune or worldly means (quranic:root_000227:B002/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Poverty is split into external lack and internal appetite, while wealth is split into possession and functional sufficiency. The contrast clarifies that abundance can fail to remove dependence when desire itself remains unbounded.

subchannels.name: Trade, liquidity, and market failure
subchannels.scene_or_process: A skilled trader seeks profit, buyers make goods current, bidders seek increase, and failed circulation ends in stagnation.
subchannels.active_motifs: trade for profit (quranic:root_000176:B001/m01); skill in earning (quranic:root_000176:B004/m01); market stagnation leading to spoilage (quranic:root_000164:B002/m01); market circulation and depletion (quranic:root_001537:B001/m01); a market becoming current (quranic:root_001273:B018/m01); competitive bidding for increase (quranic:root_000657:B004/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The imperishable trade is defined by sustained circulation, not by static possession. The same network also displays its failure mode: goods cease to move, value collapses, and the market tends toward spoilage.

subchannels.name: Expenditure, full payment, and increase
subchannels.scene_or_process: Resources leave the giver, a due return is paid without deficiency, and an additional grant exceeds the settled amount.
subchannels.active_motifs: outgoing expenditure (quranic:root_001537:B002/m01); complete payment without deficiency (quranic:root_001669:B001/m01); wage for work (quranic:root_000015:B001/m01); increase or growth (quranic:root_000657:B001/m01); surplus beyond need or division (quranic:root_001163:B001/m01); beneficent extra gift (quranic:root_001163:B003/m01); apportioned provision (quranic:root_000560:B001/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 35:29 `أَنفَقُ/رَزَقْ` (ن ف ق/ر ز ق); 35:30 `يُوَفِّيَ/أُجُورَ/يَزِيدَ/فَضْلِ` (و ف ي/ء ج ر/ز ي د/ف ض ل).
subchannels.synthesis: Payment and grace are sequential rather than synonymous: first the due is made whole, then surplus is added. Expenditure is therefore not simple loss but the outgoing stage of a completed and enlarged return cycle.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Need is answered through capacity, circulating trade, expenditure, and a return that is complete rather than depleted.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 35:15 contrasts poverty with sufficiency, and 35:29-30 describes spending, imperishable trade, full wages, and increase.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Spiritual dependence is rendered as appetite, market liquidity, bid competition, payroll, and settlement of an account.

parent_channels.name: P2 (35:15-30) Chromatic Materialization

subchannels.name: White, red, black, and composite complexion
subchannels.scene_or_process: Distinct visible hues are distributed across objects and combined into each entity's outward complexion.
subchannels.active_motifs: whiteness (quranic:root_000168:B001/m01); redness (quranic:root_000356:B001/m01); blackness opposed to white (quranic:root_000757:B001/m01); composite visible complexion (quranic:root_001387:B001/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 35:27 `بِيضٌ/حُمْرٌ/سُودٌ/أَلْوَٰنُ` (ب ي ض/ح م ر/س و د/ل و ن); 35:28 `أَلْوَٰنُ` (ل و ن).
subchannels.synthesis: The motifs form a compact chromatic system: opposed base hues and the composite complexion through which an entity is seen. The system can classify fruit, stone, and living bodies without treating them as one material.

subchannels.name: Precious surface and deceptive coating
subchannels.scene_or_process: A base object is coated with precious metal and thereby made to present the visual value of a different substrate.
subchannels.active_motifs: gold as metal (quranic:root_000522:B001/m01); gilding or gold wash (quranic:root_000522:B002/m01); coating base metal with gold or silver (quranic:root_001458:B005/m01); precious gold or silver vessel (quranic:root_001077:B018/m01); patterned or dyed cloth that misrepresents its condition (quranic:root_001290:B009/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Color can be manufactured as a persuasive surface. Gilding and patterned cloth expose the ambiguity between genuine material and a coating that borrows another material's appearance.

subchannels.name: Color as swelling and disease
subchannels.scene_or_process: A bodily or animal disorder emerges as a visible swelling whose white or red coloration marks pathology.
subchannels.active_motifs: white swelling in a horse or limb (quranic:root_000168:B012/m01); reddened swelling (quranic:root_000356:B006/m01); animal disease from surfeit (quranic:root_000356:B007/m01); ulcer or swelling emerging from the body (quranic:root_000400:B004/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 35:27 `بِيضٌ/حُمْرٌ/أَخْرَجْ` (ب ي ض/ح م ر/خ ر ج).
subchannels.synthesis: The same hue terms that pattern mountains can diagnose a body. Color becomes an index of an underlying process, with emergence and swelling explaining how an interior disorder becomes externally legible.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Color is a surface state that can differentiate matter, disguise its substrate, or register bodily disorder.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 35:27-28 repeatedly names differing colors in fruit, mountain bands, people, animals, and livestock.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Color extends from classification into metallurgy and pathology, where a coating can counterfeit value and redness or whiteness can mark swelling and disease.

parent_channels.name: P2 (35:15-30) Mountain-Water Construction

subchannels.name: Hard face and resistant excavation
subchannels.scene_or_process: An excavator encounters a raised hard mass, tests its surface, and must work against compact material that stops digging.
subchannels.active_motifs: raised hard mass (quranic:root_000217:B001/m01); hardness that stops excavation (quranic:root_000217:B005/m01); flat hard ground-face (quranic:root_000227:B007/m01); compact earth and cohesion (quranic:root_001008:B007/m01); broad smooth ground (quranic:root_000766:B009/m01); smoothed and leveled surface (quranic:root_000434:B008/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Mountain hardness is not a generic solidity motif; it is resistance encountered by a digging operation. Flatness, cohesion, and the stoppage of excavation define the worked face of the terrain.

subchannels.name: Lined well and retained water
subchannels.scene_or_process: A depression is identified, excavated or lined, and made stable enough to collect and release water.
subchannels.active_motifs: well in pasture ground (quranic:root_000227:B010/m01); stone lining and strengthening of a well (quranic:root_000621:B001/m01); rock cavity retaining rainwater (quranic:root_000434:B011/m01); water emerging and increasing (quranic:root_001458:B002/m01); hole or water outlet in ground (quranic:root_001169:B005/m01); hidden depression (quranic:root_001117:B002/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Water usefulness depends on constructed containment. The hidden or natural depression becomes a reliable well only when its walls and substrate are made firm enough to hold what emerges.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Hard terrain is made useful by finding, cutting, lining, and retaining water-bearing cavities.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 35:27 presents mountains, bands, and descending water, while 35:15-18 supplies roots whose latent senses concern holes, hardness, and load.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The mountain image resolves into a practical excavation scene with resistant rock, a lined well, a hidden depression, and emerging water.

parent_channels.name: P2 (35:15-30) Hidden-Directed Devotion

subchannels.name: Warning that awakens fear of the hidden
subchannels.scene_or_process: A warning announces danger, fear receives it with gravity, and attention is oriented toward what remains concealed from sight.
subchannels.active_motifs: warning that awakens caution (quranic:root_001488:B001/m01); fear joined with awe (quranic:root_000413:B001/m01); concealment from ordinary sight (quranic:root_001117:B001/m01); understanding and compliance after hearing (quranic:root_000741:B003/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Warning functions as an attention-changing communication, not merely a threat. Its successful reception is shown by hearing that becomes compliance and by fear directed toward a reality not available to ordinary sight.

subchannels.name: Worship, prayer, and purification
subchannels.scene_or_process: A servant submits in a specific ritual act and removes impurity from the self.
subchannels.active_motifs: prescribed worship or prayer (quranic:root_000879:B003/m01); worshipful obedience (quranic:root_000973:B003/m01); purification and moral fitness (quranic:root_000637:B002/m01); deity as object of worship (quranic:root_000047:B001/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The response to warning is embodied as ritual and purification. Worship names the relation of obedience, prayer supplies its specific practice, and purification names the change produced in the practitioner.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A warning reaches a receptive person who fears what is unseen and answers through disciplined worship and self-purification.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 35:18 joins warning, fear of the unseen, prayer, and purification, while 35:28-29 returns to fear, service, and prayer.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Fear is not passive affect: it is an alerting signal that changes attention, conduct, and ritual orientation.

parent_channels.name: P2 (35:15-30) Descent, Yield, and Renewal

subchannels.name: Water delivered from above
subchannels.scene_or_process: Water descends, is conveyed by pouring or irrigation, and becomes a life-bearing resource.
subchannels.active_motifs: downward arrival (quranic:root_001492:B001/m01); delivery or bringing down (quranic:root_001492:B002/m01); water as substance (quranic:root_001458:B001/m01); irrigation by pouring water (quranic:root_001458:B003/m01); sky or overhead source (quranic:root_000745:B004/m01); rain as provision (quranic:root_000560:B003/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 35:27 `أَنزَلَ/مَآءً/سَّمَآءِ` (ن ز ل/م و ه/س م و); 35:29 `رَزَقْ` (ر ز ق).
subchannels.synthesis: Descent is separated from delivery and from the substance delivered. This gives the rain scene a precise source-route-resource structure that can support the subsequent emergence of fruit.

subchannels.name: Fruit, returning growth, and increase
subchannels.scene_or_process: Plants flower and bear mature fruit; after prior loss or dryness, replacement growth returns and increases.
subchannels.active_motifs: mature fruit (quranic:root_000205:B001/m01); beneficial result as fruit (quranic:root_000205:B003/m01); replacement vegetation after loss (quranic:root_000433:B010/m01); tender shoot emergence (quranic:root_000810:B004/m01); blossom of a tree (quranic:root_001564:B004/m01); increase and growth (quranic:root_000657:B001/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Yield is both a botanical product and a generated benefit, but those senses remain distinct within the same productive sequence. Returning growth makes increase a renewal after loss rather than mere accumulation.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Delivered water activates a productive cycle in which plants emerge, fruit matures, and lost growth returns.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 35:27 descends water and brings out fruits, while 35:30 names increase.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The cycle includes irrigation technique, recurrent vegetation after loss, flower emergence, and fruit as both produce and beneficial outcome.

parent_channels.name: P3 (35:31-45) Textual Inheritance and Selection

subchannels.name: Hidden communication made durable
subchannels.scene_or_process: Knowledge is delivered through a hidden communicative act, fixed in writing, and authenticated by correspondence with an already established truth.
subchannels.active_motifs: hidden delivery of knowledge (quranic:root_001633:B001/m01); writing or inscription (quranic:root_001633:B003/m01); divine revelation (quranic:root_001633:B004/m01); written book (quranic:root_001283:B002/m01); truth as stable correspondence (quranic:root_000347:B001/m01); truthfulness in report (quranic:root_000852:B001/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 35:31 `أَوْحَيْ/كِتَٰبِ/حَقُّ/مُصَدِّقًا` (و ح ي/ك ت ب/ح ق ق/ص د ق).
subchannels.synthesis: Revelation is not left as an inward event. Its hidden delivery becomes publicly durable as writing, while confirmation tests that writing against a truth relation rather than against novelty alone.

subchannels.name: Inheritance, register, and succession
subchannels.scene_or_process: A predecessor's possession or knowledge passes to successors, is entered into a durable register, and becomes a trust held in the place of those before them.
subchannels.active_motifs: inheritance from a predecessor (quranic:root_001639:B001/m01); grant without purchase or contract (quranic:root_001639:B002/m01); inheritance of knowledge or scripture (quranic:root_001639:B003/m01); written register (quranic:root_001283:B004/m01); succession or replacement (quranic:root_000433:B001/m01); what is already present or preceding (quranic:root_001693:B008/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The Book is both property passed on and knowledge placed in custody. The register supplies durability, succession supplies office, and the gratuitous grant excludes acquisition as the basis of authority.

subchannels.name: Selection and graded movement
subchannels.scene_or_process: A body is purified and selected, then differentiates into one who falls short, one who keeps a middle course, and one who moves ahead.
subchannels.active_motifs: purification from admixture (quranic:root_000873:B001/m01); choosing an elite (quranic:root_000873:B002/m01); preference and selection (quranic:root_000452:B002/m01); deliberate choosing of the better (quranic:root_000452:B003/m01); precedence in a race (quranic:root_000671:B001/m01); moderation between extremes (quranic:root_001230:B003/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 35:32 `ٱصْطَفَيْ/خَيْرَٰتِ/سَابِقٌۢ/مُّقْتَصِدٌ` (ص ف و/خ ي ر/س ب ق/ق ص د).
subchannels.synthesis: Selection establishes a common entrusted body but does not erase internal difference. The race and middle-course motifs turn the three classes into distinct modes of movement under one prior act of choosing.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A truthful communication is fixed as a transmissible text, handed on as an inheritance, and entrusted to a differentiated body of recipients.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 35:31 presents revelation as the confirming truth, and 35:32 gives the Book as an inheritance to selected servants.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The transfer can be read simultaneously as inscription, gratuitous grant, succession, and a graded movement in which restraint and precedence are distinct responses to the same trust.

parent_channels.name: P3 (35:31-45) Settled Dwelling and Adornment

subchannels.name: Entry and lasting residence
subchannels.scene_or_process: Entrants cross a threshold, are settled in a house-like station, and remain there as residents rather than temporary visitors.
subchannels.active_motifs: permanent residence (quranic:root_000992:B001/m01); settling in a place (quranic:root_000351:B002/m01); dwelling or fixed abode (quranic:root_001273:B006/m01); resident attached to a house (quranic:root_000499:B007/m01); entering an enclosure (quranic:root_000464:B001/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 35:33 `يَدْخُلُ` (د خ ل); 35:35 `أَحَلَّ/دَارَ/مُقَامَةِ` (ح ل ل/د و ر/ق و م). The surface root ع د ن is unavailable in the bundle, so its permanent-residence motif cannot receive a token-level anchor.
subchannels.synthesis: Entry is only the threshold operation. Settlement, house attachment, and permanent residence convert passage into a stable condition whose defining feature is not merely location but non-expulsion.

subchannels.name: Ornament fitted to the body
subchannels.scene_or_process: Precious material is fashioned into wrist ornaments and paired with lustrous stones and clothing that complete the inhabitant's visible presentation.
subchannels.active_motifs: bodily ornament (quranic:root_000353:B001/m01); bracelet worn at the wrist (quranic:root_000758:B004/m01); wrist ornament (quranic:root_001424:B006/m01); gold as precious material (quranic:root_000522:B001/m01); pearl as ornament (quranic:root_001337:B001/m01); pearl-like lustre (quranic:root_001337:B002/m01); garment worn on the body (quranic:root_001341:B001/m01); silk fabric (quranic:root_000306:B010/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 35:33 `يُحَلَّ/أَسَاوِرَ/ذَهَبٍ/لُؤْلُؤًا/لِبَاسُ/حَرِيرٌ` (ح ل ي/س و ر/ذ ه ب/ل ء ل ء/ل ب س/ح ر ر); 35:41 `يُمْسِكُ/أَمْسَكَ` (م س ك).
subchannels.synthesis: Adornment is assembled as a material sequence: substance, formed ornament, bodily placement, lustre, and garment. This keeps the scene from collapsing into a generic sign of wealth.

subchannels.name: Contact without grief or fatigue
subchannels.scene_or_process: Grief is removed, and neither effort nor exhaustion can reach the settled inhabitants as an affecting contact.
subchannels.active_motifs: toil and fatigue (quranic:root_001507:B004/m01); weakness from exhaustion (quranic:root_001360:B001/m01); an effect reaching a person by contact (quranic:root_001423:B004/m01); grief as inward roughness (quranic:root_000317:B001/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 35:34 `حَزَنَ` (ح ز ن); 35:35 `يَمَسُّ/نَصَبٌ/لُغُوبٌ` (م س س/ن ص ب/ل غ ب).
subchannels.synthesis: Relief is expressed as failed transmission: fatigue and weariness no longer touch the body, while grief has already departed the interior. The dwelling is therefore secure at both the external and affective boundaries.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Arrival becomes secure habitation when entry, residence, bodily adornment, and relief from exhausting contact all stabilize together.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 35:33-35 moves from entry into gardens through jewelry and clothing to a lasting dwelling untouched by weariness.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The scene is architectural and somatic at once: a granted residence is fitted to the body with wrist ornaments and garments, while pain, grief, and fatigue lose the capacity to make contact.

parent_channels.name: P3 (35:31-45) Interior Knowledge and Disclosure

subchannels.name: Concealed source and inward content
subchannels.scene_or_process: A content is withheld from ordinary eyes, lodged in the chest or heart as a source of action, yet remains available to complete knowledge.
subchannels.active_motifs: concealment from sight (quranic:root_001117:B001/m01); chest as inner enclosure (quranic:root_000849:B001/m01); chest as source of outward acts (quranic:root_000849:B004/m01); hidden heart or inward core (quranic:root_000266:B010/m01); knowledge of inner conditions (quranic:root_000387:B001/m01); comprehensive knowledge (quranic:root_001040:B001/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Hiddenness is a limit on ordinary reception, not on knowability. Chest, heart, and inner condition locate the source from which action issues, making later judgment responsive to concealed formation as well as visible deed.

subchannels.name: Sight, insight, and evidentiary showing
subchannels.scene_or_process: Eyes receive an object, reflection converts reception into insight, and a claimant is required to bring the alleged object into manifest view.
subchannels.active_motifs: visual perception (quranic:root_000121:B001/m01); inward discernment or insight (quranic:root_000121:B002/m01); causing something to be seen (quranic:root_000531:B012/m01); reflective looking (quranic:root_001520:B001/m01); emergence into view (quranic:root_000970:B001/m01); manifestation as proof (quranic:root_000170:B004/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Seeing is partitioned into reception, reflective interpretation, and demonstrative showing. The demand to show what partners created therefore exposes a failure of evidence, not merely a failure to look.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: What is hidden within or beyond ordinary perception remains fully knowable and can be brought into evidentiary view.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 35:31 and 35:38 join divine seeing with knowledge of the unseen and of what chests contain, while 35:40 and 35:44 demand visible evidence and reflective looking.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The channel distinguishes concealment, inward source, visual reception, insight, and public manifestation instead of treating knowledge and sight as interchangeable.

parent_channels.name: P3 (35:31-45) Fire, Death, and Failed Exit

subchannels.name: Fire without terminal death
subchannels.scene_or_process: Fire is experienced as punishment, but the decree that would complete life is withheld and the burden of the ordeal is not reduced.
subchannels.active_motifs: consuming fire (quranic:root_001564:B002/m01); decree brought to completion (quranic:root_001237:B003/m01); completion or expiration of a term (quranic:root_001237:B004/m01); loss of life (quranic:root_001454:B001/m01); experiential tasting (quranic:root_000526:B002/m01); painful punishment (quranic:root_000994:B005/m01); reduction of a burden (quranic:root_000427:B001/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 35:36 `نَارُ/يُقْضَىٰ/يَمُوتُ/يُخَفَّفُ/عَذَابِ` (ن و ر/ق ض ي/م و ت/خ ف ف/ع ذ ب); 35:37 `ذُوقُ` (ذ و ق).
subchannels.synthesis: Death, expiration, and lightening are distinct terminal operations. Their coordinated refusal creates persistence: the fire continues, the sufferer remains alive to experience it, and intensity is not reduced.

subchannels.name: Cry, unanswered aid, and blocked departure
subchannels.scene_or_process: A trapped group raises a loud appeal for aid and asks to cross outward, but neither helper nor exit relation is established.
subchannels.active_motifs: loud cry (quranic:root_000855:B001/m01); cry for rescue (quranic:root_000855:B002/m01); answering a cry with aid (quranic:root_000855:B003/m01); departure from an enclosure (quranic:root_000400:B001/m01); external support (quranic:root_001510:B001/m01); deliberate corrective action (quranic:root_001046:B001/m01); prior warning (quranic:root_001488:B001/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 35:37 `يَصْطَرِخُ/أَخْرِجْ/نَعْمَلْ/نَّذِيرُ/نَّصِيرٍ` (ص ر خ/خ ر ج/ع م ل/ن ذ ر/ن ص ر); 35:42 `نَذِيرٌ` (ن ذ ر).
subchannels.synthesis: The cry lexically contains the expectation of response, yet the scene supplies no answering helper. Requested exit and promised corrective action arrive only after the prior warning, so neither reopens the closed process.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Punishment becomes a closed process when fire persists, death is withheld as an endpoint, relief is denied, and cries fail to establish an exit relation.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 35:36-37 describes fire, uncompleted death, unlightened punishment, tasting, cries, and a rejected request to leave.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Legal completion, sensory tasting, aid, and spatial exit separate several ways an ordeal might terminate and show each one failing independently.

parent_channels.name: P3 (35:31-45) Cosmic Retention and Capacity

subchannels.name: Holding against displacement
subchannels.scene_or_process: Vast bodies tend toward movement or removal but are actively grasped and restrained in their appointed relation.
subchannels.active_motifs: holding and restraint (quranic:root_001424:B001/m01); removal from a place or state (quranic:root_000655:B001/m01); movement and instability (quranic:root_000655:B002/m01); sky as overhead structure (quranic:root_000745:B004/m01); earth beneath the sky (quranic:root_000025:B001/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Stability is recast as successful restraint of possible motion. The heavens and earth are not inert background; their continued relation is the present result of holding against displacement.

subchannels.name: Effective capacity and failed escape
subchannels.scene_or_process: Power is sufficient to execute an intended act, while any object that might resist or flee fails to escape its reach.
subchannels.active_motifs: effective capacity to act (quranic:root_001205:B003/m01); strength like joined cord strands (quranic:root_001274:B001/m01); inability or incapacitation (quranic:root_000985:B001/m01); escape beyond another's reach (quranic:root_000985:B002/m01); hand as operative power (quranic:root_001693:B002/m01); bodily or structural strength (quranic:root_000782:B002/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 35:31 `يَدَيْ` (ي د ي); 35:44 `يُعْجِزَ/قَدِيرًا/قُوَّةً/أَشَدَّ` (ع ج ز/ق د ر/ق و ي/ش د د).
subchannels.synthesis: Capacity is measured by successful execution, not by an abstract attribute. The failed-escape sense of inability places the opposing object inside the same reach that performs cosmic restraint.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Ordered space persists because a capable agent restrains its parts from displacement and cannot be defeated by any competing force.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 35:41 describes the heavens and earth as held against removal, and 35:44 denies that anything can incapacitate God.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Holding, instability, escape, hand-power, and cord-like strength materialize cosmic order as an ongoing exertion rather than a static arrangement.

parent_channels.name: P3 (35:31-45) Historical Tracks and Governed Change

subchannels.name: Traveled way and inherited custom
subchannels.scene_or_process: Repeated movement wears a recognizable road; later travelers follow it as both physical route and inherited practice.
subchannels.active_motifs: customary governing path (quranic:root_000750:B001/m01); journeying through land (quranic:root_000769:B001/m01); way or established custom (quranic:root_000769:B002/m01); path or adopted doctrine (quranic:root_000522:B007/m01); straight directed path (quranic:root_001230:B002/m01); road worn by passage (quranic:root_001046:B011/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The invariant pattern is not only a rule but a traveled way made legible by repetition. Physical journey, moral direction, and inherited custom remain distinguishable while explaining why earlier outcomes can instruct later occupants.

subchannels.name: Succession without alteration of the pattern
subchannels.scene_or_process: One human cohort replaces another and conditions alternate, yet neither substitution nor redirection alters the governing pattern.
subchannels.active_motifs: substitution of one thing for another (quranic:root_000095:B001/m01); change of form or condition (quranic:root_000095:B002/m01); transfer from one state to another (quranic:root_000373:B001/m01); succession by replacement (quranic:root_000433:B001/m01); alternation between occupants or states (quranic:root_000433:B006/m01); ordered succession (quranic:root_001033:B005/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Human succession is genuine change within history, whereas the governing pattern is the condition under which those changes recur. The explicit denial of substitution and diversion prevents the two levels from being collapsed.

subchannels.name: Respite, fixed term, and arrival
subchannels.scene_or_process: Seizure is postponed for a measured interval, earlier actors do not outrun the later outcome, and the appointed endpoint finally arrives.
subchannels.active_motifs: fixed appointed term (quranic:root_000016:B001/m01); postponement of an act (quranic:root_000019:B002/m01); granting time or respite (quranic:root_001520:B002/m01); outcome that follows an act (quranic:root_001033:B006/m01); being earlier in time (quranic:root_001198:B002/m01); coming and arrival (quranic:root_000281:B001/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Delay changes timing but not destination. The fixed term bounds respite, while arrival and outcome explain why earlier peoples provide evidence even when present seizure has not yet occurred.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Human succession moves along inherited tracks toward an appointed outcome, while the governing pattern itself resists substitution or diversion.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 35:39 makes humans successors, 35:43 names an invariant divine pattern, and 35:44-45 directs travel, comparison, and delay to a fixed term.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Road wear, doctrinal path, alternation, postponement, and arrival turn history into movement whose local occupants change but whose governing route and endpoint remain stable.

parent_channels.name: P3 (35:31-45) Moral Accounting

subchannels.name: Action acquired and returned
subchannels.scene_or_process: An agent intentionally performs an act, acquires it as part of the self's account, and meets the consequence that follows it.
subchannels.active_motifs: intentional action (quranic:root_001046:B001/m01); recompense according to deed (quranic:root_000244:B001/m01); acquisition by one's act (quranic:root_001296:B001/m01); consequence or final outcome (quranic:root_001033:B006/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The sequence preserves agency at every stage: intention produces an act, the act is acquired to its performer, and recompense is the act's returned outcome rather than an unrelated imposition.

subchannels.name: Increase, advantage, and compounded loss
subchannels.scene_or_process: A position can grow into surplus and precedence, while a losing transaction compounds the deficit already attached to its agent.
subchannels.active_motifs: general loss or diminution (quranic:root_000409:B001/m01); commercial loss (quranic:root_000409:B002/m01); increase and growth (quranic:root_000657:B001/m01); surplus beyond sufficiency (quranic:root_001163:B001/m01); advantage or higher degree (quranic:root_001163:B002/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Increase and loss are directional accumulations, not binary verdicts. The trade sense of loss makes disbelief a worsening account, while surplus and degree show the opposite possibility of value exceeding its starting measure.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Intended action accrues to its agent and returns as a consequence that can increase rank or compound loss.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 35:36-39 and 35:43-45 repeatedly join disbelief, action, recompense, increase, loss, plotting, and earned seizure.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Commerce, growth, precedence, and earned acquisition make consequence cumulative and agent-bound rather than a single externally imposed event.

parent_channels.name: P3 (35:31-45) Oath, Warning, and Aversion

subchannels.name: Strengthened pledge
subchannels.scene_or_process: Speakers invoke the divine name and bind themselves with their strongest oath, treating the pledge as an obligation that must later be discharged.
subchannels.active_motifs: oath as binding speech (quranic:root_001226:B004/m01); oath used for confirmation (quranic:root_001698:B003/m01); divine name invoked in oath (quranic:root_000047:B002/m01); adjuration by life (quranic:root_001044:B002/m01); discharging a sworn obligation (quranic:root_000351:B005/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The oath is a speech act with maximal force, not evidence of later compliance. Invoked name, life-stakes force, and discharge sharpen the subsequent failure by specifying what the speakers claimed to bind.

subchannels.name: Warning arrives, response recoils
subchannels.scene_or_process: A warning reaches its addressees with directional guidance, but reception turns into bodily and affective withdrawal.
subchannels.active_motifs: warning before consequence (quranic:root_001488:B001/m01); coming or arrival (quranic:root_000281:B001/m01); aversion and recoil (quranic:root_001532:B001/m01); guidance toward a way (quranic:root_001583:B001/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Arrival completes the condition anticipated by the oath, but not its promised response. Guidance offers a direction of movement; aversion names movement in the opposite direction.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A maximally strengthened pledge creates an obligation of receptivity, but the arrival of its promised warning can still disclose withdrawal rather than guidance.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 35:42 reports emphatic oaths to heed a warner and then records greater aversion when a warner arrives.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Divine naming, life-stakes adjuration, arrival, and bodily recoil expose the distance between verbal commitment and enacted response.

parent_channels.name: S1. P1 (35:1-14) Kindled Heat and Consuming Fire
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Heat intensifies until material catches, fire consumes what is fed to it, and ignition can expand into open conflict.
parent_channels.active_motifs: intense heat (quranic:root_000014:B002/m01); fire consuming its fuel (quranic:root_000043:B005/m01); kindling a fire (quranic:root_000708:B001/m01); kindling war (quranic:root_000708:B002/m01); transformation by burning (quranic:root_000862:B009/m01)
parent_channels.synthesis: The latent scene pressures the adversarial summons of 35:6 by giving fire a process: heat, fuel, ignition, and transformation. The war sense remains a distinct escalation of kindling rather than a synonym for combustion.

parent_channels.name: S2. P1 (35:1-14) Cordage, Binding, and Joined Ends
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Fibers are doubled into cord, tightened as restraint or fastening, and joined end-to-end to hold separated parts in relation.
parent_channels.active_motifs: doubled rope or rein (quranic:root_000208:B007/m01); shackle or restraining cord (quranic:root_000582:B009/m01); sandal thong (quranic:root_000791:B004/m01); long fastening rope (quranic:root_000796:B002/m01); dangling end or appendage (quranic:root_000994:B006/m01); joining two facing parts (quranic:root_001198:B010/m01)
parent_channels.synthesis: Doubling, fastening, and joining form a material channel of relation under tension. It gives the otherwise slight image of the date-stone membrane in 35:13-14 a neighboring vocabulary of fibers and appendages without merging those distinct objects.

parent_channels.name: S3. P1 (35:1-14) Distance, Rupture, and Nearness
parent_channels.scene_or_process: An object is brought near or held below a boundary, while another is driven away until relation becomes rupture or ruin.
parent_channels.active_motifs: spatial distance (quranic:root_000131:B001/m01); causing separation (quranic:root_000131:B003/m01); ruin figured as being driven far away (quranic:root_000131:B004/m01); remoteness and cutoff (quranic:root_000796:B001/m01); nearness (quranic:root_000493:B001/m01); proximity below a limit (quranic:root_000502:B001/m01)
parent_channels.synthesis: Distance is not merely location: it can be actively produced until companionship and access fail. The near/below-limit motif in 35:13 keeps the invoked powers spatially proximate in formulation while 35:14 makes them relationally unreachable.

parent_channels.name: S4. P1 (35:1-14) Accountability, Judgment, and Cover
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A harmful act is exposed to reckoning and judgment, while forgiveness covers the act or shields its consequence.
parent_channels.active_motifs: accountability for fault (quranic:root_000018:B002/m01); painful punishment (quranic:root_000994:B005/m01); forgiveness as protection (quranic:root_001096:B002/m01); decisive judgment (quranic:root_000348:B002/m01); opening a dispute by judgment (quranic:root_001124:B003/m01)
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 35:2 `حَكِيمُ/يَفْتَحِ` (ح ك م/ف ت ح); 35:6 `ٱتَّخِذُ` (ء خ ذ); 35:7 `عَذَابٌ/مَّغْفِرَةٌ` (ع ذ ب/غ ف ر).
parent_channels.synthesis: The channel distinguishes exposure to judgment from the protective operation that could cover consequence. The opening sense of judgment usefully reverses the mercy-opening of 35:2: opening may release a gift or initiate a decisive case.

parent_channels.name: S5. P1 (35:1-14) Celestial Measures of Time
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Moon, night, and daylight divide duration into observable stations and recurring periods.
parent_channels.active_motifs: moon and reflected light (quranic:root_001255:B001/m01); lunar station or measured stage (quranic:root_000148:B004/m01); full-moon night (quranic:root_000766:B012/m01); night as darkness and time (quranic:root_001392:B001/m01); opening into daylight (quranic:root_001559:B002/m01); daytime as manifest interval (quranic:root_001700:B001/m01)
parent_channels.synthesis: The subjection of sun and moon in 35:13 is reframed as temporal governance: light-bearing bodies make duration legible through stations and alternation. The full-moon branch adds a peak phase without collapsing moon, night, and day into one motif.

parent_channels.name: S6. P2 (35:15-30) Replacement by a New Creation
parent_channels.scene_or_process: An existing population departs, another newly made population arrives, and succession preserves continuity while changing occupants.
parent_channels.active_motifs: bringing into creation (quranic:root_000434:B002/m01); newness after nonexistence (quranic:root_000227:B004/m01); successor replacing a predecessor (quranic:root_000433:B001/m01); alternation between occupants (quranic:root_000433:B006/m01); coming or arrival (quranic:root_000009:B001/m01); departure from a place (quranic:root_000522:B006/m01)
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 35:16 `يُذْهِبْ/يَأْتِ/بِخَلْقٍ/جَدِيدٍ` (ذ ه ب/ء ت ي/خ ل ق/ج د د); 35:27-28 `مُّخْتَلِفًا/مُخْتَلِفٌ` (خ ل ف).
parent_channels.synthesis: Replacement is decomposed into departure, arrival, new production, and succession. This keeps 35:16 from reading as simple destruction: the operative image is a controlled exchange of occupants.

parent_channels.name: S7. P3 (35:31-45) Deceptive Promise and Recoiling Harm
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A glittering promise creates false hope, matures into a concealed harmful plan, and finally turns back upon its maker as loss.
parent_channels.active_motifs: deception by attractive appearance (quranic:root_001078:B008/m01); promise that creates expectation (quranic:root_001662:B001/m01); threatened outcome (quranic:root_001662:B002/m01); evil descending or encircling its agent (quranic:root_000381:B001/m01); adverse turn or defeat (quranic:root_000499:B004/m01); loss and diminution (quranic:root_000409:B001/m01)
parent_channels.synthesis: Promise and threat are separated as opposed expectations generated by the same speech relation. Glitter conceals the harmful trajectory, while encirclement explains how the plotted evil returns to the agent who projected it outward.

parent_channels.name: S8. P3 (35:31-45) Marital Household and Bodily Life Cycle
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A household relation is formed through marriage, shared residence, clothing, and affinity, then persists through aging and possible abandonment.
parent_channels.active_motifs: unmarried or abandoned woman (quranic:root_000180:B007/m01); wedding night before consummation (quranic:root_000306:B016/m01); spouse as household companion (quranic:root_000351:B006/m01); affinity formed by marriage (quranic:root_000791:B003/m01); repudiation by marital formula (quranic:root_000970:B010/m01); reaching old age (quranic:root_000985:B003/m01)
parent_channels.synthesis: These remote senses gather around household formation and its vulnerabilities, offering a human-scale counter-scene to permanent residence in 35:33-35. The channel remains latent: it does not recast the gardens as marriage, but tests permanence against ordinary bonds that age, rupture, or fail.

parent_channels.name: S9. P3 (35:31-45) Woven Structure, Fold, and Wear
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Threads or strips interlace into cloth, receive folds and creases, and eventually show wear or altered condition.
parent_channels.active_motifs: interlacing parts into a structure (quranic:root_000464:B008/m01); first fold of cloth (quranic:root_001226:B007/m01); striped lines like straps (quranic:root_000769:B004/m01); fold or crease (quranic:root_001078:B001/m01); worn cloth (quranic:root_000434:B009/m01); changed or decayed condition (quranic:root_000433:B007/m01)
parent_channels.synthesis: Interlacing and folding materialize ordered construction at a small scale, while wear supplies a latent model of alteration. This scene usefully pressures the contrast between changeable created structures and the cosmic order held from displacement in 35:41.

parent_channels.name: S10. P3 (35:31-45) Stone Surface, Seal, and Inscription
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A hard surface is smoothed or sealed, retains water in a hollow, and can receive a durable written mark.
parent_channels.active_motifs: smooth bright stone (quranic:root_000121:B007/m01); sealed solid rock (quranic:root_000434:B012/m01); clean smooth stone (quranic:root_000873:B006/m01); hard even surface (quranic:root_000852:B002/m01); hard site that retains water (quranic:root_001424:B004/m01); inscription cut into stone (quranic:root_001633:B010/m01)
parent_channels.synthesis: The stone senses join hardness with reception: a surface can resist change yet hold water or preserve inscription. That tension offers a material analogue for a stable written revelation and a retained cosmic order without merging those primary scenes.

parent_channels.name: S11. Whole Surah (35:1-45) Sowing, Water-Lifting, and Harvest
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A cultivator works an apportioned field with paired-ox yoke bars, covers seed, lifts and routes water, watches grain form, and carries the cut crop to the threshing floor.
parent_channels.active_motifs: sharecropping and field cultivation (quranic:root_000387:B003/m01); paired-ox plow-yoke bars (quranic:root_000741:B015/m01); covering seed with earth (quranic:root_001307:B008/m01); water-lifting machine (quranic:root_000373:B016/m01); watering field and crop (quranic:root_001438:B005/m01); grain forming in the crop (quranic:root_001348:B011/m01); carrying harvest to the threshing floor (quranic:root_000582:B006/m01)
parent_channels.synthesis: This worked-field sequence materializes the revivified earth of 35:9 and the yield of 35:27 as hidden seed, delivered water, formed grain, and lifted harvest. It also preserves the agency claim of 35:3: cultivators can prepare, irrigate, and gather, but neither the rain nor the life activated by it originates in their tools.

parent_channels.name: S12. Whole Surah (35:1-45) Lure, Snare, and Verified Quarry
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Hunters go out, draw an animal from its burrow, set a snare, test a bow, pursue successive quarry, verify death after the strike, and identify the catch as food.
parent_channels.active_motifs: setting out to hunt (quranic:root_000745:B006/m01); drawing an animal from its burrow (quranic:root_000452:B006/m01); hunter's snare (quranic:root_000791:B006/m01); testing a bow by its string and flex (quranic:root_000526:B003/m01); successive taking of game (quranic:root_000993:B008/m01); checking whether struck game has died (quranic:root_001454:B014/m01); prey prepared for eating (quranic:root_000043:B007/m01)
parent_channels.synthesis: The hunt supports the fresh-meat provision of 35:12 by supplying the missing capture and verification process. Its lure-and-snare mechanism also usefully pressures the adorned evil and hostile summons of 35:5-8 and the recoiling plot of 35:43: attraction directs quarry into a capture structure whose danger is concealed until contact.

parent_channels.name: S13. Whole Surah (35:1-45) Prepared Perfume and Spreading Scent
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Camphor and aromatic spices are prepared at a perfume brazier, applied as a coating to body or cloth, and released as a fragrance that spreads beyond its source and reaches the sense of smell.
